articles.summary: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mar. 30, 2026-- Quince Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: QNCX) today announced the successful settlement of the company’s outstanding obligations under its loan from the European Investment Bank (EIB) for a payment of $5.5 million.
articles.title: Quince Therapeutics Settles Approximately $16.4 Million of Debt
